6
A car travels at constant speed along a straight road that has a slight downwards slope.
Which statement is correct?
A
There is a resultant force on the car down the slope.
B
There is a resultant force on the car up the slope.
C
There is a resultant force on the car vertically downwards.
D
There is no resultant force on the car.

options.label: A
options.text: There is a resultant force on the car down the slope.

options.label: B
options.text: There is a resultant force on the car up the slope.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a resultant force on the car vertically downwards.

options.label: D
options.text: There is no resultant force on the car.
